name: Orygen TGD Service – headspace Sunshine
title: Youth trans and gender diverse health service
description: The Orygen TGD Health Service provides access to safe and gender-affirming care and support to young people (aged 12-25) who are transgender, gender diverse or questioning their gender, including peer workers, mental health clinicians and a GP. It provides assessment for access to Gender Affirming Hormone Therapy for people under 18, and access to GAHT via the Informed Consent Pathway for people over 18. Self-referral by contacting the headspace centre.
specialties: youth gender affirming care, gender affirming hormone therapy, peer navigation, GP care, mental health
